AN_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Optional severity floor applied client-side on the issues surface. Accepts the canonical Faraday enum (info / low / medium / high / critical) plus AssetNote-side aliases (Important / Major / Moderate / Informational / Negligible / Sev1..Sev5 / P1..P5). Defaults to '' (no filter; we emit the full hits surface). Garbage values are logged and ignored.

AN_PAGES.description: Optional per-surface page-walk cap. Each AssetNote v1 search page returns up to 100 hits via limit=100; AN_PAGES bounds the offset walk so a stray operator filter can't fan out into 100k+ requests against the rate-limited AssetNote API. Numeric / numeric-string input accepted; floats are floored. Clamped to [1, 50]. Defaults to 5 (~ 500 hits per surface, 1000 total across assets + issues).

name: assetnote
title: AssetNote
description: AssetNote EASM importer. Pulls externally-discovered assets and issues from the AssetNote (now Searchlight Cyber AssetNote / Continuous Security) REST API and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. Each AssetNote asset becomes one Faraday host (ip = the asset's first public IP, falling back to synthetic 0.0.0.0 for domain-keyed assets); per-asset issues attach as one Faraday vulnerability per issue_id with the [EASM] engine prefix. Endpoints used: GET /api/v1/assets (paginated external-asset inventory; the canonical AssetNote pivot - every issue joins by asset_id) and GET /api/v1/issues (paginated issue inventory with severity + category + cves + remediation guidance). Pagination is offset-based: limit=100 per page, offset advanced via the response envelope's next_offset cursor (or current_offset + page_size when the envelope is silent), walked page-by-page until the page comes up short or AN_PAGES is reached. Severity bucketing walks the string severity field first (Critical / High / Medium / Low / Info) and falls back to priority / risk_rating / risk_score (AssetNote 0-10 scale) then CVSS when nothing else lands; aliases collapse AssetNote-side labels (Important / Major / Moderate / Informational / Negligible / Sev1..Sev5 / P1..P5) onto the canonical Faraday bucket. Status mapping covers new / in_progress / investigating / triaged -> open, resolved / closed / remediated / fixed / mitigated / patched -> closed, and false_positive / risk_accepted / accepted_risk / wont_fix -> risk-accepted. Refs include AssetNote-Asset / AssetNote-AssetName / AssetNote-AssetType / AssetNote-Id / AssetNote-Category / AssetNote-Port pivots plus any url / reference_url / evidence_url surfaced on the issue. Auth: AssetNote uses a single long-lived API key created in the AssetNote console under Settings -> API Keys -> New. The dispatcher carries the key on every request as the Authorization: Bearer <AN_API_KEY> header. AN_HOST is the AssetNote tenant host (e.g. api.assetnote.io); service-account keys carry the tenant scope so no workspace param is required. Tags: [assetnote, easm].
